column1: # THE DIFFS A PLAYER BUILD IS KNOWN TO WRITE INTO THE TREE (2026-09-29, COMPLETED.md s672) - read by Tools/build_player.ps1, which restores a file
# only when EVERY changed line of its diff (git diff -U0, the +/- content without the sign) matches one of its patterns here; anything else fails the
# build and is left for inspection. Indentation is part of each pattern: UnityConnectSettings.asset carries six m_Enabled lines, and only the
# top-level one (two spaces) may change. Measured on the build of s672 (Unity 6000.5.6f1).
